title: TO-DOs in scripts (explorer)
description: Explorer for open work in script comments across three notations (TO DO, FIX IT, TBD). Click a count to filter the result list. Inventory, not a rule: the bundle deliberately declares no result value, so it stays out of the health check and carries no tile chip — the counting half of the family are the rules script_comment_fixme (warning) and script_comment_todo (info).
